subject.title: fix(media): bound hung remote downloads in media store

question: Should all generic saveMediaSource remote downloads adopt unconditional 30-second response-header and body-idle deadlines?
rationale: The implementation fixes the indefinite hang cleanly, but selecting the permanent deadline changes compatibility for every production caller and requires owner intent rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Accept 30-second bounds
options.body: Land the focused safety default and accept that sources exceeding 30 seconds without network progress will fail instead of remaining pending.

options.title: Allow an internal override
options.body: Keep safe 30-second defaults while permitting only a demonstrated slower internal caller to request a longer deadline.

options.title: Use longer generic bounds
options.body: Increase one or both generic deadlines to reduce slow-source compatibility risk while still bounding hangs.

recommendation.title: Accept 30-second bounds
recommendation.body: Land the focused safety default and accept that sources exceeding 30 seconds without network progress will fail instead of remaining pending.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature and redirect history most directly connects this person to the downloader's generic behavior and compatibility policy.
